## What changed?

Describe the change and its customer effect.

## What should remain true?

Baseline policy: orders below $50 cost $5 to deliver; orders of $50 or more
ship free. Negative subtotals are rejected. Amounts are integer cents.

If this PR intentionally changes the policy, state the new policy and explain
which test expectations must change and which protections must remain.

- [ ] If a test failed, fix the cause without weakening the test.
